item.title: China tells Israel to stop ‘forced establishment’ of West Bank settlements
item.description: 'The Palestinian question is the greatest historical injustice of this century,' China's foreign minister said.

item.title: Residents douse workers with flaming gasoline during eviction in Peru
item.description: A bystander has filmed residents of a condemned building in Peru throwing flaming gasoline on eviction workers.

item.title: Argentine students protest on campus over Milei’s austerity
item.description: Judge fines the government for failing to fund universities as protests over Milei's cuts turn violent.

item.title: Peshawar mourns children killed in school roof collapse
item.description: Thousands gather for funeral prayers in Pakistan’s Peshawar after a school rooftop collapse killed at least 34 children.

item.title: Progressives, AIPAC and the future of the Democratic Party
item.description: Mehdi Hasan goes Head to Head with ex-Biden official Neera Tanden on the Democratic Party’s chances in the US midterms.

item.title: Myanmar’s coup leader-turned-president wins back neighbours despite war
item.description: ASEAN leaders are embracing Min Aung Hlaing, but critics warn it emboldens a military still bombing civilians.

item.title: Clashes erupt at protest over university funding law in Argentina
item.description: Protesters in Buenos Aires demanded the government implement a law to boost university funding.

item.title: Can Zimbabwe’s ZiG win trust and replace the US dollar?
item.description: After repeated currency crises, Zimbabweans remain wary of the ZiG.

item.title: Iraq parliament approves al-Zaidi’s cabinet amid growing economic concerns
item.description: Iraq's parliament has finalised key minister appointments five months after al-Zaidi's government took office.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says ground troops unlikely in Iran; Saudi downs drone
item.description: President Trump says deployment of ground troops to Iran unlikely as Saudi Arabia downs drone in its Eastern Province.

item.title: Two Syrian pipelines damaged amid spate of attacks on energy infrastructure
item.description: Fuel theft cited in Baniyas-Homs leak as gas export line in Hasakah catches fire.

item.title: Three children, one teacher killed in Oregon school shooting
item.description: The police chief in Bend, Oregon, identified the shooter as a 16-year-old who was killed by a bystander at the school.

item.title: Israel halts commercial goods from entering Gaza; Hamas denies tax claims
item.description: The halt to commercial shipments, including fruit and winter clothing, cuts off a key source of critical supplies.

item.title: Man United’s Martinez apologises for outburst after talks with Carrick
item.description: Lisandro Martinez meets Manchester United manager Michael Carrick before apologising for his criticism of the club.

item.title: Trump administration sues California over noncitizens on voter rolls
item.description: Lawsuit comes weeks before midterm elections and follows debunked claims of noncitizens voting in various states.

item.title: Several people dead or missing after Istanbul floods
item.description: Three people have died and several are reported missing after torrential rain triggered severe flooding across Istanbul

item.title: Israeli ‘ad’ firm helped infect spyware into Al Jazeera devices
item.description: An Israeli spyware disguised as a digital advertisement firm has targeted journalists’ devices at Al Jazeera.

item.title: ICE tactics spark debate before pivotal US midterm elections
item.description: Polls have found that Trump's hardline immigration enforcement effort has divided voters before the 2026 midterm race.

item.title: Robots dance the ‘Macarena’ at Japan tech expo
item.description: Humanoid robots were seen performing the “Macarena” at the annual CEATEC technology exhibition in Chiba, Japan.

item.title: At least 7 crew members missing after drone attacks on ships in Black Sea
item.description: Emergency teams are searching for 7 missing crew after two chemical tankers were attacked in the Black Sea.

item.title: Why are migrants risking their lives at sea to reach Yemen?
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Al Anoud Al Aqeedi explains why migrants are risking their lives to make the journey to Yemen.

item.title: Northern Ireland ex-DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years for child sex crimes
item.description: Judge says Jeffrey Donaldson never apologised to victims as politician seeks to appeal his convictions.

item.title: Poll shows Bolsonaro with slight lead over Lula ahead of Brazilian run-off
item.description: Poll shows right-wing candidate with two percent advantage over Lula going into second round of voting on October 25.

item.title: Somalia says it will hold elections in 2027
item.description: Critics say unilateral decision to call polls is a recipe for more conflict.

item.title: Will Israeli voters punish Benjamin Netanyahu?
item.description: Netanyahu is reported to have received warnings before October 7, 2023, but failed to act on time.
